track_b.name: Filtered
rules: Same shortlist from the outlook data. Singles are unchanged.
Skip Under bets (both lines) in Premier League and LaLiga 2.
Slips: at most one leg per league.
Slips: skip legs priced shorter than -300 if the other leg is also shorter than -300.
Slips: skip legs where the model chance beats the book by more than 10 points, or where the edge is negative.
track_b.note: The Premier League and LaLiga 2 rule was chosen after seeing results, so the earlier-days numbers for it are a backtest. Only results from 2026-11-08 on are a fair test.
